name: filter-row
title: Filter row
description: The row of controls above a list: search, your filters and a Reset that counts what is active, folding into one Filters button and a sheet on a phone.
docs: Your filters are rendered once and moved between the row and the sheet, so they keep their state, an open panel included. Server rendered, the markup already has the phone's shape at the default 640px (CSS decides until the page is interactive); another `collapseBelow` applies once it is. Reset calls `onReset`, and clearing your filters is yours to do; Done only closes the sheet. Keep the filters controlled so a page reload can restore them. A facet filter's button sizes to its picks, so the controls after it make room when they change.
